def longest_palindrome(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp = [[False] * n for _ in range(n)]
    start = 0
    max_len = 1
    
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        dp[i][i] = True
        if i < n - 1 and s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            dp[i][i + 1] = True
            start = i
            max_len = 2
    
    for length in range(3, n + 1):
        for i in range(n - length + 1):
            j = i + length - 1
            if s[i] == s[j] and dp[i + 1][j - 1]:
                dp[i][j] = True
                start = i
                max_len = length
    
    return s[start:start + max_len]

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    t = int(data[0])
    results = []
    
    index = 1
    for _ in range(t):
        s = data[index]
        result = longest_palindrome(s)
        results.append(result)
        index += 1
    
    for result in results:
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def find_longest_palindrome(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_len = 1
    result = s[0]
    
    # Check all substrings centered at each character
    for i in range(n):
        left, right = i, i
        while left >= 0 and right < n and s[left] == s[right]:
            if right - left + 1 > max_len and s[:left] == s[n-1:right-1:-1]:
                max_len = right - left + 1
                result = s[left:right+1]
            left -= 1
            right += 1
    
    # Check all substrings starting from each character
    for i in range(n):
        left, right = i, i + 1
        while left >= 0 and right < n and s[left] == s[right]:
            if right - left + 1 > max_len and s[:left] == s[n-1:right-1:-1]:
                max_len = right - left + 1
                result = s[left:right+1]
            left -= 1
            right += 1
    
    return result

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    t = int(data[0])
    results = []
    
    index = 1
    for _ in range(t):
        s = data[index]
        index += 1
        result = find_longest_palindrome(s)
        results.append(result)
    
    for result in results:
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
